title: 2026 GRADE 10 PHYSICAL EDUCATION MS T2
text:
MARKING SCHEME
SECTION A (30 MARKS)
 1. (a) Corner Kick.
 (b) Kick-off.
 (c) Both feet on ground, ball from behind head.
 (d) True. (6 mks)
 2. (a) Flip pass.
 (b) Running pass.
 (c) X-Elbow, Y-Wrist.
 (d) Maintain momentum/score while moving. (6 mks)
 3. (a) Crossover dribble.
 (b) Lay-up is close/off backboard; Jump shot is from distance/vertical leap.
 (c) Faking: body move; Feinting: ball move to deceive.
 (d) Low center of gravity. (6 mks)
 4. (a) S-Lead leg, T-Trail leg.
 (b) 800m, 1500m.
 (c) Conserving energy for the final kick. (6 mks)
 5. (a) portable toilet.
 (b) Drainage, security, water source.
 (c) Prevent wild fires/safety. (6 mks)
SECTION B (50 MARKS)
 6. (a) Side-on stance, stay between goal and opponent.
 (b) Stance, Contact, Follow-through.
 (c) Organizing the wall/marking targets.
 (d) Protect head, land on soft parts. (12 mks)
 7. (a) Feet too narrow, lack of focus on rim.
 (b) Using eyes/shoulders to pull defender out of position.
 (c) "Cookie jar" flick/downward snap.
 (d) Crossover requires lower, wider hand switch. (12 mks)
8. (a) Lean forward, pump arms, shorten stride.
 (b) Curved start.
 (c) Landing: on ball of foot; Recovery: trail leg snaps forward.
 (d) Length: distance per step; Frequency: speed of steps. (13 mks)
9. (a) 1. Sleeping bag, 2. First aid kit, 3. Stove.
 (b) Clearing site, spreading tent, inserting poles, pegging.
 (c) Understanding biodiversity and conservation.
 (d) Requires resourcefulness and coordination under pressure. (13 mks)
